prompt: A planned grid city with numbered avenues.

card.name: Grid City of Numbered Avenues

site.text: A planned grid city with numbered avenues, laid out on level ground in regular blocks

style.text: Orderly, uniform streetscape with consistent materials; numbered avenue signs at every corner

purpose.text: A planned city to live, trade and govern in

card.interpretation: You asked for a planned grid city with numbered avenues. I took that as a large, level, orderly city of regular blocks, with avenues numbered by signs. The style is uniform and tidy rather than a named theme, and the purpose is a market town for living and trading, with a city hall and market hall as centrepieces.
assumptions: Size L, to fit a grid within the 64-block claim radius
Style left open: uniform materials, no named theme
Purpose read as market town with civic buildings

program.notes: Civic centrepiece at the middle of the grid, facing the main plaza
Covered market on the central plaza
Uniform terraced homes lining the numbered avenues
Taller multi-storey homes near the centre
Public house on a busy crossing

Small chapel on a quiet block
